primaryWitnesses.text: When the LORD was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, “Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”

wikipediaRead.title: Gilgal
wikipediaRead.locator: 導入および「In the Book of Kings」節、表示行139–141、180–182
wikipediaRead.readExcerpt: Gilgal is the name of one or more places in the Hebrew Bible. In the Books of Kings it is a home of a company of prophets; the text suggests the Gilgal was near Bethel and likely differs from Joshua’s Gilgal near Jericho, though opinions differ.
